item.title: Flames & Facts — Thu Sep 10, 7:00 PM — Student Center Quad/Student Center Ballrooms
item.description:
As part of Campus Fire Safety Awareness Month this September, we are planning a large-scale educational event focused on raising awareness about fire safety within the campus community. The highlight of the event will be a live burn demonstration using the National Fire Sprinkler Association's (NFSA) Side-by-Side Trailer. This will feature two mock dorm rooms—one with a sprinkler system and one without—to showcase the dramatic impact fire safety systems can have during a fire.The goal of the event is to educate students about the importance of working smoke detectors, not blocking or tampering with sprinkler heads, and understanding that while sprinkler systems may cause water damage, they ultimately save lives.
Hosted by: Campus Activities, Fire Safety
Additional Information can be found at: https://montclair.campuslabs.com/engage/event/12693308
Source: Montclair State University

item.title: The Assembly of Lovers - Sufi Drum Circle — Mon Sep 14, 7:00 PM — the Space
item.description: Community drum and chant circle rooted in Sufi prayer. Meets every other Monday: September 14, September 28, etc. Contribution: Sliding scale donation $20–$40 (no one will be turned away) This is a vibrant Community Drum and Chanting Circle, where we drum and chant from our hearts into the universe. This experience is open to absolutely everyone, regardless of background or belief system—all that’s required is an open heart and a willingness to connect through sound. The term ‘lover’ in this context refers to seekers on the Sufi path who are longing for union with the divine energy. You can think of this gathering as an expansion of the sema sufi meditations we used to offer. item.title: Simple Sitting Meditation (15 minutes) — Wed Sep 16, 11:00 AM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream In these sessions, I will be doing guided meditations where we simply sit and notice what arises.
There is no agenda and no plan for how these sessions unfold. I might start off simply by asking us to notice what is already present. By becoming aware of what’s going on in our heads and in our body.
Then, the meditation may take on a life of its own.
Our job is to simply be present to what arises. We may notice the mind moving and chattering about. Or we may notice that it’s completely silent.
The goal here, if there is one, is to simply let ourselves be as we are.
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: Mindful Masculinity: Exploring Conscious Brotherhood — Wed Sep 16, 7:00 PM — the Space
item.description:
We Meet Bi-Weekly, Every Other Wednesday · 7:00 – 8:30 PM · $15 Through open dialogue, mindfulness, and other calming practices, we quiet the mind, open the heart, and deepen our connection to ourselves and each other. The circle is open to all male identifying individuals. Meetings are hosted by Leo A. Sante – mindfulness coach, teacher, and dad. We start by sharing our wins and challenges, honoring each voice without judgment or advice. From there, we move into practices that help us release stress, shift perspective, and bring awareness and resilience into our lives. Each week centers on a different theme to help guide us – trust, accomplishment, family, rest, intimacy, presence – as we discover new ways to move through the world as mindful men. Come as you are. Leave more grounded, connected, and inspired. Connect with Leo: Instagram: @holdingpresence Online: HoldingPresence.com Email: pe***********@***il.com
Source: The Space For Art

item.title: Women's Breakfast (Assembly Room) — Sat Sep 19, 9:00 AM — Assembly Room and Kitchen
item.description:
Our “Kick-Off” Women’s Breakfast on Saturday September 19th at 9:00am, will have us traveling to India with our own Deb Williams. Since her first visit in 2009, Deborah Williams has returned to India six times to travel, study yoga, chanting, and philosophy, and immerse herself in the culture. Through photographs and personal stories, she will share some of the places, traditions, and experiences that continue to draw her back—and reflect on the lessons she continues to bring home. Come and join us for a fascinating and informative morning. A delicious breakfast, with gluten-free options, will be served. The cost will be $7.00. Please RSVP to Karen Ermler, karen.ermler@gmail.com, so we can plan accordingly. Guests are always welcome. Hope to see you there!
Source: Union Congregational Church

item.description:
Tech Talks is a free informational series where library staff introduce and explain the technology topics that matter most in today's digital world. Each session takes a closer look at a new or complex topic—whether it's a trending app, an emerging technology, or a platform you've been hearing about but aren't quite sure how to navigate. Through demonstrations and clear, jargon-free explanations, you'll come away with a better understanding of the tech landscape around you. There's no hands-on component, so no devices are needed—just come ready to learn and ask questions.

item.title: North Pocono Happy Hike — Sun Sep 13, 9:00 AM
item.description:
Metrotrails: NJ, PA, NY Metropolitan Area Hiking and More! Join us on this point-to-point hike, tracing historic Rail lines and other interesting and random stuff through the Northern tier of the Pocono Mountains. We meet on the Old State Road at the trailhead for the North Pocono Rail Trail. From here, we will head West and shuttle with his few cars as possible to our start. from there, we will meander along some abandoned railroad beds, as well as some old turnpike routes, with only very short bits of road between. There may be one bridge on the way those with height issues won't like. Aside from that, the route is almost entirely clear and easy. Some might have uneven service, and only about 3 mi is improved surface. Everyone should come prepared with everything they need because we are only passing by one location where we can refill on any food or drink.Distance is about 15 mi. If needed, contact me at 908 343 8374
Source: Meetup: Metrotrails Hiking
